scope: SmolLM2-135M BF16 c1 P128 O32; GUI retained; five fresh AB/BA process pairs

campaign_labels.batch3: HTTP readiness and worker wakeup batch
campaign_labels.batch4: packed decode projections and RoPE KV fusion batch

aggregation.process_values: Arrays follow pair_indices; each lane has one fresh process per pair.
aggregation.latency: Each value is a retained process median, P95 or P99; summary median/range spans processes.
aggregation.paired_ratio: Riley/vLLM within the same pair, then median/range; not a ratio of campaign medians.
aggregation.changes: 100 * (new/previous - 1), using medians of process statistics or same-pair ratios; campaigns are separate trials.
aggregation.tails: Nearest-rank tails from 30 requests per process, not pooled 150-request percentiles or high-concurrency stability.
aggregation.evidence: Completed runner summaries only; raw artifacts are not revalidated by this analysis.

semantics.latency: HTTP E2E and first nonempty text event; first text is not token-aligned TTFT.
semantics.throughput: Observed retained-request wall interval, including gaps between requests.

semantics.latency: Engine request TTFT, mean TPOT and E2E from exact-token-validated runs.
semantics.throughput: Output tokens divided by sum of request E2E service durations; excludes inter-request gaps.
